conclusion: No evaluated news specification demonstrated reliable incremental out-of-sample predictive value under the pre-specified criteria in the current sample.

immutability_note: This artifact records a completed study. A later protocol version that performs differently does not revise it; that is a different study with its own artifact.

controls_plus_news.description: Lagged market controls together with news features.

disagreement.description: Cross-outlet disagreement about the same events.

event_tone_novelty.description: Event-level tone with entity novelty and corroboration.

headline_count_only.description: Attention proxy with no tone information.

market_controls_only.description: Lagged market factors, no news at all.

net_tone_share.description: Positive minus negative share of events.

previous_direction.description: Sign of the previous session's target return.

features.standardisation: training fold only, applied to test fold

folds.embargo_rationale: drops the session adjacent to each test fold so a story spanning two sessions cannot appear on both sides

reduced.reason: 25 training sessions against up to six features is roughly four observations per parameter; the design can detect nothing it should be believed about, so its verdict is capped at inconclusive

folds.selection_rule: by session count, before any model is fitted

missing_values.policy: drop the row for that specification; never impute zero
missing_values.rationale: a zero feature asserts neutrality that was never measured

logistic.description: L2-regularised logistic regression on the return sign.

mean.description: Training-fold mean; the null a model must beat.

ridge.description: L2-regularised least squares on standardised features.

prohibited: fitting preprocessing on a test fold
contemporaneous controls in a tradable specification
reporting significance without accounting for repeated sessions

sample.market_recap_reason: recap tone follows the return by construction

protocol_specification.status_note: Retrospective walk-forward exploration on already-collected data. Not an untouched future test.

success_criteria.failure: no news feature set clears the margins, or the sample gate blocks the comparison
success_criteria.inconclusive: margins cleared in fewer than a majority of folds, or fewer than three folds are fittable
success_criteria.reporting_rule: failure and inconclusive results are reported in full; the protocol is not re-run with different settings to obtain a different answer
success_criteria.success: a news feature set beats every baseline on MAE and directional accuracy by the stated margins, in a majority of folds, with session-cluster-aware intervals excluding the baseline

target.direction_label: sign of the primary target, zero excluded

primary.definition: percent return from the open to the close of the first session able to react to the news
